output.title: Renovated 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
This 220 m² penthouse resides in Luxembourg's Belair neighborhood, known for its upscale residential character. Recently renovated, the apartment combines contemporary design with elevated comfort across expansive living spaces.

The open-plan living room benefits from floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light and frame panoramic views of the city. Oak parquet flooring and a wood-burning fireplace add refinement and warmth, complemented by integrated smart-home lighting that enhances convenience.

The adjacent kitchen features a sleek, minimalist design with professional-grade Gaggenau appliances and a central Carrara marble island, ideal for culinary preparation and entertaining. Matte black fixtures and an integrated wine fridge contribute to the modern aesthetic.

Four bedrooms include a master suite with a walk-in closet, ensuite bathroom, and direct access to a private terrace. The spacious master terrace, along with an additional large terrace, offers south-facing exposure and unobstructed 180-degree views of Luxembourg City, finished with composite decking and glass balustrades.

Additional amenities include a cellar for storage, parking facilities, and an elevator for convenient access. The residence presents a refined living environment within one of Luxembourg's well-regarded neighborhoods, balancing urban proximity with a green, quiet setting.

highlights.text: 220 m² renovated penthouse with open-plan living
Panoramic south-facing city views from terraces
Gaggenau appliances and Carrara marble kitchen island
Four bedrooms including master with walk-in closet and ensuite
Private terraces with composite decking and glass balustrades
